## Complete Project Catalog & Technical Case Studies

### 1. Munjez (منجز) — Cross-Platform Productivity Desktop & Mobile Application
- Summary: A full-featured, offline-first productivity desktop and mobile application designed to organize tasks, track daily habits, manage focus sessions, and integrate Hijri/Gregorian schedules.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Smart Task Manager: Priority levels, tag categorization, search filters, completion statistics.
  - Dual Calendar System: Integrated Hijri (Islamic) and Gregorian 4-view calendar with custom event scheduling.
  - Focus Engine: Customizable Pomodoro timer with audible break notifications.
  - Habit Streak Analyzer: Visual streak tracking and progress analytics.
  - Ambient Sound Mixer: Multitrack white noise player (Rain, Waves, Fire, Cafe).
- Tech Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Tauri 2.0, Rust, Vite, Firebase, Tailwind CSS.
- Target Platforms: Windows (x64), Linux (x86_64 AppImage), Android.
- Status: Shipped, Free & Open Source Releases.
- Web Link: https://munjez-website.vercel.app
- Source Code: https://github.com/Osama2214/munjez-releases

### 2. PC Builder (منشئ الكمبيوتر) — E-Commerce & Hardware Compatibility Engine
- Summary: A specialized full-stack e-commerce web platform featuring an automated component compatibility verification algorithm for custom PC builders.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Compatibility Engine: Algorithmic validation of CPU socket matching, Motherboard chipsets, RAM generations (DDR4/DDR5), and Power Supply Unit (PSU) wattage requirements.
  - E-Commerce Suite: Dynamic cart drawer, checkout flow, price calculator, product search, filter by specifications.
  - Admin Portal: Full CRUD inventory control, order management, revenue analytics.
- Tech Stack: PHP 8, Laravel, MySQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5.
- Source Code: https://github.com/Osama2214/PC-Builder

### 3. Osama Café — Interactive Restaurant Management & Ordering System
- Summary: A web-based order processing and menu management system built for cafes and dining venues.
- Key Capabilities: Categorized interactive menu, dynamic order drawer, real-time receipt total calculator, kitchen order status tracking, admin control panel.
- Tech Stack: PHP, MySQL, Vanilla JavaScript, CSS3.
- Source Code: https://github.com/Osama2214/osama-cafe

### 4. Portfolio OS — Web Desktop Operating System Experience
- Summary: A lightweight, web-based desktop operating system simulator built directly into Osama Ahmed's portfolio site.
- Features: Drag-and-drop windows, taskbar, desktop icons, Settings app, Terminal app, Minesweeper & Snake games, ambient audio player.
- Tech Stack: Vanilla JavaScript (Zero Dependencies), CSS Grid/Flexbox, HTML5.
- Live Web Link: https://osama-portfolio-six.vercel.app/
